title: Quantum State Preparation via Neural Network Encoding in Quantum Machine Learning
summary: A central challenge in quantum machine learning is the state preparation bottleneck that describes the prohibitive computational cost of loading high-dimensional classical data into a quantum state. Although amplitude encoding can represent $2^n$-dimensional data using only $n$ qubits in principle, preparing arbitrary states remains computationally expensive, typically requiring variational optimization of a parameterized quantum circuit for each individual data instance.
